examples.name: Apple
examples.brief: A red orchard apple with short brown stem and one green leaf. Add a shallow stem cavity and clear leaf midrib only.

examples.name: Banana
examples.brief: One curved yellow banana with short stem, brown tip and a few broad longitudinal ridges. No peel opening or extra fruit.

examples.name: Frosted doughnut
examples.brief: A golden ring doughnut with pink frosting, open center, organized scalloped boundary and sparse pastel sprinkles, leaving broad clear areas.

examples.name: Carrot
examples.brief: A stout orange carrot, tapered root and compact green leafy top. Two or three broad root notches and distinct leaf clusters converge at the crown.

examples.name: Teacup with tea and saucer
examples.brief: A white cup of amber tea on a matching shallow saucer, right loop handle, blue rims, one blue flower with green leaves and subtle steam curl. Shared perspective and meaningful cast shadows; no extra utensils.
decoration: one blue flower with green leaves

examples.name: Mixing bowl
examples.brief: A blue bowl holding three red apples and two green pears. Keep the rim, curved walls and base visible; coordinate rim ellipse, fruit overlaps and contact shadows. No utensils or scattered food.

examples.name: Soup ladle
examples.brief: A silver-gray ladle with deep scoop, rolled lip, coherent neck and curved handle with one hanging hole. No added contents.

examples.name: Wooden spatula
examples.brief: A warm-brown wooden spatula with broad blade, rounded handle, clear blade shoulder, thinner working edge and hanging hole. Quiet wood surface, no decorative grain.

examples.name: Cutting board
examples.brief: A warm-brown rectangular board with rounded corners, integral handle opening and shallow perimeter juice groove. No food or tools.

examples.name: Pillar candle
examples.brief: An unlit cream-white pillar candle, shallow top depression, short brown wick, one restrained wax drip and clean base. No flame, smoke or holder.

examples.name: Cushion
examples.brief: A blue square cushion with plump body, rounded corners, broad cream geometric diamond motif and matching edge piping. No dense textile microtexture.

examples.name: Wicker basket
examples.brief: A warm-brown basket holding two golden bread rolls and one short baguette. Keep broad weave, top rim and arched handle dominant; coherent overlaps and contact shadows, simple bread scoring. No wrapper, crumbs or flowers.
contents: two bread rolls and one short baguette

examples.name: Soap bar
examples.brief: A pale-yellow soap bar with domed top, rounded rectangular body and one shallow leaf emboss. Otherwise clear surface.

examples.name: Claw hammer
examples.brief: A steel-gray claw hammer with warm-brown handle. Resolve striking face, split curved claw and head connection. No loose nails or tools.

examples.name: Flathead screwdriver
examples.brief: A red-grip screwdriver with silver-gray shaft, broad grip flutes, clear ferrule and consistent flat tip. No screws or tools.

examples.name: Basketball
examples.brief: One orange basketball with coherent recognizable dark curved seam channels. No logo, added pattern or dense pebbled texture.

examples.name: Bicycle helmet
examples.brief: A deep-blue helmet with domed shell, broad vents, liner border, attached chin straps, coherent junctions and simple buckle. No loose accessories.

examples.name: Trumpet
examples.brief: A golden trumpet with flared bell, connected looping tubes, three valve buttons and mouthpiece. One coherent camera; no stand, case or note decoration.

examples.name: Backpack
examples.brief: A teal-blue backpack with padded body, front pocket, top handle, attached straps, broad zipper bands, gray pulls and strap adjusters. One small plain orange fabric tab; no text, dangling accessories or flowers.

examples.name: Erlenmeyer flask
examples.brief: An empty pale-blue glass flask with conical body, narrow neck, rounded lip, coherent wall thickness, shoulder and flat base. Sparse short graduation marks; no liquid, stopper, bubbles or text.

default_assumption: Generic candidate; exact additions and arrangement are compiler proposals, not inherited user facts.
